result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked zebra crosswalk, curb ramps, and a paved multi-use path. However, the environment is dominated by a wide roadway with multiple lanes and lacks visible pedestrian-specific signals or a refuge island, increasing exposure risk.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals are visible, which can lead to confusion about when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide roadway with marked crosswalks and basic signalization, but is dominated by a large gas station with multiple vehicle access points. Pedestrians face significant exposure due to the crossing width and potential conflicts with vehicles entering or exiting the commercial property.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the main roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road.

hazards.name: Multiple Conflict Points
hazards.description: The gas station has wide, undefined entry and exit points that cross the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the gas station frontage.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Narrow and clearly define the entrances to the gas station to reduce the area of conflict with the sidewalk.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk across a multi-lane one-way street. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the long crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands increase risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow paved roadway or multi-use path through a heavily wooded area with no dedicated pedestrian infrastructure. There are no sidewalks, crosswalks, or lighting visible, creating a shared space environment that lacks formal protection for people walking.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian separation
hazards.description: Pedestrians must share the narrow paved surface with any potential vehicle traffic due to the absence of a sidewalk.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Dense vegetation and trees right up to the edge of the pavement limit sightlines around potential curves.
hazards.location_in_image: Background and sides of the path

interventions.title: Pedestrian-scale lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during dawn, dusk, and nighttime.

interventions.title: Shared space signage
interventions.description: Install signage to alert any vehicle operators to the presence of pedestrians and establish a low-speed shared environment.
